name: Winter Rift 2025 - Night
creator: thekillerey
description:
Experience Summoner’s Rift during a cold and magical winter night with Winter Rift 2025 – Night.

This mod transforms the entire Rift into a snow-covered nighttime battlefield filled with frozen terrain, icy structures, festive props, glowing decorations, and deep blue lighting.

The darker atmosphere creates a calm and mysterious winter feeling, while glowing map elements and warm holiday details add contrast throughout the Rift.
